ITC Infotech to Acquire Stake in Happiest Minds for Rs 1,330 Crore

ITC Infotech announced its plan to acquire a 22% stake in Happiest Minds Technologies for Rs 1,330 crore. Following the acquisition, ITC Infotech intends to merge its operations with Happiest Minds. The combined entity is projected to target revenues of $1 billion. This deal aims to consolidate operations and expand market reach.
